column1: # comment: "Erotetic-slice alignments to schema.org's QA vocabulary. The match is deliberately loose (skos:closeMatch, not equivalentClass): schema.org models the QA SPEECH ACT / PAGE \u2014 a schema:Question is a posted question on a QAPage with schema:acceptedAnswer / schema:suggestedAnswer answers \u2014 whereas gmeow:Question is answerhood-individuated CONTENT, the third content sibling of gmeow:Proposition and gmeow:Goal, neither true/false nor a page. gmeow:answers ranges over vantage-indexed claims (P9), not a single accepted answer, so the schema:acceptedAnswer / schema:suggestedAnswer distinction has no gmeow counterpart and is folded into the standpoint layer. The competency-question (CQ) practice familiar from ontology engineering \u2014 a Question as a requirement a model must answer \u2014 is the natural consumer of this slice but has no stable IRI vocabulary to map to, so it is referenced in prose only. The question-type vocabulary (gmeow:typeWh / gmeow:typePolar / \u2026) has no stable external IRI counterpart and is intentionally left unmapped."

column6: schema:Question models the QA SPEECH ACT / posted question on a QAPage; gmeow:Question is answerhood-individuated CONTENT (the third content sibling of Proposition and Goal), neither true/false nor a page. closeMatch, not equivalentClass.

schema:answer links a question to an Answer; its schema:acceptedAnswer / schema:suggestedAnswer lineage (QAPage practice) picks ONE accepted answer, whereas gmeow:answers is vantage-indexed and coexisting (P9) — several answers, none privileged, acceptance carried on the epistemics spine. closeMatch.
